trace.title: Q21: SELECT p.sku, p.product, p.country, p.sku_category, p.currency, p.current_price, s.period,

detail.sql:
SELECT p.sku, p.product, p.country, p.sku_category, p.currency, p.current_price, s.period, s.yoy_pct, s.source_id
FROM psig.v_price_list_ex1027 p
JOIN (
  SELECT country, period, yoy_pct, source_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY period DESC) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT country, period, yoy_pct, source_id FROM psig.v_fr_food_prc_hicp_minr_cp01_ex1027 WHERE yoy_pct IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT country, period, yoy_pct, source_id FROM psig.v_it_food_prc_hicp_minr_cp01_ex1027 WHERE yoy_pct IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT country, period, yoy_pct, source_id FROM psig.v_es_food_prc_hicp_minr_cp01_ex1027 WHERE yoy_pct IS NOT NULL
  ) u
) s ON p.country = s.country AND s.rn = 1
WHERE p.country IN ('FR', 'IT', 'ES')
ORDER BY p.country, p.sku

    endpoint "https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/prc_hicp_minr?format=JSON&geo=FR&coicop18=CP01&unit=RCH_A&sinceTimePeriod=2024-08&lang=EN",
    method "get",
    response_type "json",
    http_encoding "URLENCODED"
) HEADER (
) BODY ()

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW v_fr_food_prc_hicp_minr_cp01_ex1027 WITH CONTAINER psig AS
SELECT 'FR' AS country, 'food' AS concept, 'CP01' AS category_code, 'Food and non-alcoholic beverages' AS category_label,
       'M' AS frequency, time_label AS period, CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS yoy_pct,
       'eurostat:prc_hicp_minr:CP01:RCH_A' AS source_id
FROM psig_eurostat.eurostat_fr_prc_hicp_minr_cp01_ex1027
LATERAL VIEW explode(from_json(to_json(value), 'map<string,double>')) AS k, v
LATERAL VIEW explode(from_json(to_json(dimension.time.category.index), 'map<string,bigint>')) AS time_label, idx
WHERE CAST(k AS INT) = idx
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(period) AS latest FROM psig.v_fr_food_prc_hicp_minr_cp01_ex1027 WHERE yoy_pct IS NOT NULL
